ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) surface with approximately 25-30% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixel distribution appearing as localized clusters and distal mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast circular white blobs distributed across both lobes; concentrated mottling and light-colored pixel patches are visible along the trailing edges and at the distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 115 degrees and a moderate bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary with pixel-amplitude variations ranging from 3 to 12 pixels; serrations become more acute and prominent towards the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory sweeping outwards and dorsally from the median notch towards the fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive detection of localized circular white pixel clusters (rosettes) consistent with barnacle attachment sites, scattered throughout the dark ventral surface of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several unaligned light-grey linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible; notably, a series of diagonal parallel lines on the medial portion of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced yellowish-brown pixel clusters and irregular texture at the distal-most tips of both lobes, suggesting significant biofouling or chronic abrasion.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple low-intensity rounded objects in the foreground water corresponding to pinniped heads; high-intensity white water turbulence (foam) at the fluke-water interface.
